committee: *Presentation of Certificate No. 393-38 (COR) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Certificate No. 393-38 (COR), recognizing the recipients’ dedication to honoring Philippine heritage and strengthening unity between Guam, the United States, and the Filipino community; and to commend their leadership in founding the annual Philippine Independence Day Flag Raising Ceremony in 2006. Presentation will take place during Guam Reef Hotel’s Annual Flag Raising Ceremony commemorating the 128th Philippine Independence Day on Friday, June 12 beginning at 7:30AM at the Guam Reef Hotel. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 6/9/26 12:31 p.m. (FN)
